note: Unofficial English names and text for cards that were never printed in English (FC01, BT11-055, PR cards and G cards with no English source; user's request, 2026-10-30). Used only when a card has no official English record; the game marks them as unofficial translations. Text follows the official English templates of the time (Nov 2014); the official Japanese text stays canonical.

FC01-001.name: Mighty Spear Liberator, Bleoberis
FC01-001.text:
[AUTO][Limit-Break 4](This ability is active if you have four or more damage):[Counter-Blast 1] When a <Gold Paladin> rides this unit, you may pay the cost. If you do, look at up to two cards from the top of your deck, search for up to two <Gold Paladin> from among them, call them to separate open (RC), put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order, choose one of your vanguards, and that unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of that battle.
[CONT](VC/RC):Lord (If you have a unit without a clan in common with this unit, this unit cannot attack)

[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, if your opponent has three or more cards in his or her damage zone, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of that battle.
[CONT](VC/RC):Lord (If you have a unit without a clan in common with this unit, this unit cannot attack)
